name: valid-ai-ted-scorer
description: CSA's Valid-AI-ted scoring method (published package 1.1.0) with seven documented fixes, and reference data for every current CAIQ and AI-CAIQ version: scores a completed CAIQ (CCM) or AI-CAIQ (AICM) question by question on a 0-4 scale and writes a scored workbook and a summary PDF. An informational, AI-assisted assessment of the written responses, produced by your AI assistant. Read the README's known issues first.
